attack_paths.scenario_title: SQL injection at login and user lookup
attack_paths.description: Unsanitized request data interpolated into SQL query syntax lets an attacker alter query logic, bypass credential checks, or extract records from any row in the database.

attack_paths.scenario_title: Command injection via unauthenticated admin route
attack_paths.description: Caller-controlled values interpolated into shell command strings give an attacker arbitrary code execution on the server, limited only by the process's operating-system privileges.

attack_paths.scenario_title: All runtime secrets via unauthenticated debug route
attack_paths.description: Operational or debug surfaces that serialize internal state, secrets, or configuration without authentication expose every credential to any caller who can reach the service.

attack_paths.scenario_title: Token forgery via hardcoded signing key
attack_paths.description: Predictable or hardcoded session-signing material allows an attacker to produce valid credentials for any identity without going through the authentication flow.

attack_paths.scenario_title: Unauthenticated access to user records and admin operations
attack_paths.description: Routes that accept identity or authorization parameters from the caller without verifying them against an authoritative server-side record allow horizontal and vertical privilege escalation.
